floor_history.headline: Recon: honest floor 4 confirmed (candidate applied, HEAD was 9); m2c proves target C shape == our candidate, so the 4-insn gap is two GCC-internal optimizer decisions, not a missing source shape.

frontier.hypothesis: H1 strength-reduce suppression: get GCC to keep biv `ptr` with 0x332/0x334 displacement instead of combining the two givs into new biv q=ptr+0x332.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c strength_reduce + combine_givs allocates a giv-biv for ptr+0x332 and expresses ptr+0x334 as +2; target leaves both as replaceable (cost-0) displacement givs off ptr.
frontier.next_probe: Instrumented cc1 loop.c / -da RTL dump on the candidate .i to read the combine_givs benefit calc; derive a C form that keeps both accesses replaceable-displacement givs. (WIP already killed u16-stride-1, for-index, comma-init, no-guard do-while.)

frontier.hypothesis: H2 operand-swap: flip the pointer add so the shift-result pseudo sorts before the param pseudo, yielding `addu s2,v0,s0`.
frontier.mechanism: GCC canonicalizes commutative plus by pseudo regno; param a0 < local v0, so a0 lands rs. Target had the shift-result pseudo lower.
frontier.next_probe: greg/RTL dump to read the two pseudos + conflicts; try copying a0 into a fresh local consumed only by the add (materialized after the shift) to reorder pseudo assignment. (WIP killed source-order rewrites: uintptr cast, byteptr-first, explicit s2_int — all add conversion insns.)

frontier.hypothesis: H3 permuter from the floor-4 base may find a structural lever outside the manual playbook.
frontier.mechanism: randomized/directed structural search re-seeded from the closer base (score 4) explores forms the hand-derived levers missed.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o (offset 0 via asm/funcs + prelude.inc) and run decomp-permuter from candidate.c with --stop-on-zero under fresh-seed discipline; harvest in-turn.
